numbering_system.description: Redken Shades EQ uses level + tone letter codes. Levels 0-10, tone letters appended to level.

lines.name: Shades EQ
lines.description: Demi-permanent acidic conditioning color gloss. No ammonia, no lift. Lasts 4-6 weeks.

strengths.0: Shades EQ Processing Solution (dedicated acidic developer)

processing_solution.use: Dedicated acidic processing solution for all Shades EQ shades

gray_coverage.rule: Shades EQ provides grey blending, not full coverage. For 100% grey coverage, use Color Gels Lacquers or add permanent color.
gray_coverage.blending: Ideal for blending grey and adding tone without lift
gray_coverage.recommended: Use NN (Double Natural) shades for best grey blending results

use_cases.glossing: Apply to pre-lightened or natural hair for shine and tone
use_cases.toning: Neutralize unwanted tones on pre-lightened hair
use_cases.refreshing: Revive faded color between permanent services
use_cases.grey_blending: Blend grey without full coverage using NN or N shades

processing_times.deeper_penetration: Up to 25 minutes for resistant hair

clear.use: Dilute any shade, add shine without color deposit
clear.mixing: Mix with any shade to reduce intensity
